description: This file defines the Password controller class for the account password management in the OpenCart platform. It includes methods for displaying the password change form and saving the new password, handling validation, and redirecting appropriately.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the user password change functionality within the account section of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the password change form page, setting up breadcrumbs and page data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the user's password, performs validation, updates the database, and returns a JSON response with success or error messages.
